cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a foley recording booth with microphones and boxes of noisy props — carries an acoustic guitar by its neck at her side; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her front; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — crouching low on her heels; A night tram interchange with red and turquoise light reflected in the glass roof — She watches the last two trams pass in opposite directions before deciding which side of the city to visit; a self-service car wash bay — holds her keepsake at chest height; A sheltered mountain swimming cove with a dawn-lit floating timber platform — She tests whether the first sunlight has reached the water before taking her morning swim; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a bath-house changing room of wooden lockers — perched on a ledge or edge; a starship galley and mess hall — holds a bowl of hot food at chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — holds a small hand lantern low at her side
